summary: Audited PR #549 and patched trial reminders so Clerk-backed organizations can receive owner email lookup when legacy created_by is null.
findings: PR #549 was open and mergeable with green CI/security workflow runs before the patch.
Automated review identified that trial reminders selected only organizations.created_by, so Clerk-backed organizations with created_by_clerk_user_id and null created_by were skipped.
vercel.json still has one daily internal maintenance cron.

The change is non-breaking: it adds created_by_clerk_user_id to the existing organization select, falls back to legacy created_by, and uses the resolved owner id consistently for email/audit metadata.
actions_taken: Recorded this audit action in agent_log.d to avoid truncating the large root agent_log.json.
next_cycle_focus: Wait for PR #549 checks to rerun on the patched head commit.
If all checks pass, PR #549 can be merged; production remains no-go until merge-commit checks run.
